notes: kb/Work PB5242 landed. §1985:XIII.3.8.4 GR1 sets the page regions, LAST DETAIL "the last line number on which a control heading or detail report group may be presented". GroupLimits and ScreenReportGroupLines refuse each region an absolute line violates (COBOL2199) and LowerLimit drives the run-time fit. The two 2002 phrases that changed the regions at 85, LAST CONTROL HEADING and the page width, are now refused there (report-page-forms-2002), so a 1985 control heading is bounded by LAST DETAIL alone. Witnesses: 1985-GR-XIII_3_8_4-1 and pb5242-page-forms-85. Each 2002 form is refused at --std 85 with COBOL0900 by a construct row of the version matrix (tests/version-matrix/constructs/report-*-2002.json, introducedIn 2002), checked on recognition in VersionConformancePass's parse arm, and accepted from COBOL-2002 (ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 115).

next.reason: 1985 d): 'LAST DETAIL integer-4 defines the last line number on which a control heading or detail report group may be presented'; the PAGE clause has page size, HEADING, FIRST DETAIL, LAST DETAIL, FOOTING. 2023 §2023:13.18.39.4 GR2 adds cases: 'Integer-5 is the LAST CONTROL HEADING integer. It defines the last line position on which any line of a control heading may be printed' and 'Integer-6 is the LAST DETAIL integer. It defines the last line position on which any line of a detail may be printed' (LAST DETAIL no longer bounds control headings when LAST CONTROL HEADING is written), and 'Integer-2 is the page width'. 2023 accepts PAGE clauses 1985 refuses, with a control-heading limit 1985 cannot express: a case added, so CHANGED. A 1985 program keeps its limits: §2023:13.18.39.4 GR3 c) 'If LAST CONTROL HEADING is omitted, integer-5 will be equal to integer-6, if LAST DETAIL is specified', else FOOTING, else the page limit, the 1985 GR2 default of LAST DETAIL; HEADING, FIRST DETAIL and FOOTING regions are the same (§2023:13.18.39.4 GR1, GR2; §2023:13.18.39.4 GR4 RH/RF on a page by itself; §2023:13.18.57.4 GR7 upper and §2023:13.18.57.4 GR8 lower limits, 'The lower limit for a control heading is the line given by the LAST CONTROL HEADING integer').
